title: Scripture and the Gospel
definition: Scripture and the Gospel means the Bible reveals the good news of God’s saving work through the death, resurrection, and reign of Jesus Christ.
summary: Scripture and the Gospel means the Bible reveals the good news of God’s saving work through the death, resurrection, and reign of Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the Gospel’s center: the promised Savior who died for sinners, rose from the dead, and brings people to God by grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Gospel is not invented by the Church; it is revealed in Scripture. God’s Word tells the truth about sin, judgment, grace, Christ’s atoning death, His resurrection, and the call to repentance and faith.

Scripture keeps the Gospel clear. Without the Bible, the Gospel can be reduced to self-help, moral improvement, religious belonging, emotional comfort, or social identity. Scripture shows that sinners need salvation and Christ is the Savior.

The whole Bible moves toward and flows from the good news of Jesus. The promises, sacrifices, prophecies, and apostolic witness all testify that salvation is by God’s grace through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry shame, guilt, addiction, fear, and spiritual confusion because they do not know what God has done in Christ. Scripture and the Gospel announces that sinners are not saved by cleaning themselves up but by coming to Jesus.

This doctrine also protects ministry from losing its center. A church or tool may speak of help and hope, but if it loses the Gospel, it loses the saving message.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Return often to the Gospel as Scripture declares it. Believe Christ’s finished work, repent of sin, reject performance-based acceptance, and share the good news with others as the Holy Spirit gives opportunity.
